primary_reference.title: Thermodynamic Reassessment and Phase Diagram Calculations of the Fe–P and Fe–C–P Systems

Table_S1.txt.source: word/document.xml paragraph text, extracted in order

transcription.location: Table 1, printed p.355 / PDF p.5, visually inspected; independently matched to original Table S1 TDB
transcription.binary_ideal_basis: chemical species Fe, P, Fe2P; atomic counts Fe=n_Fe+2*n_Fe2P and P=n_P+n_Fe2P

scope.common_reference: Analytical binary Henry-to-free-P conversion, preserving the existing measured gas-anchored Henry standard. No phase-outcome fit.
scope.multicomponent_extension: Retain existing host/cross terms on collapsed total Fe/P amounts; replace only the old P-P self term. This is a declared constitutive extension, not binary-data validation of all cross interactions.
scope.pressure: No calibrated pressure response for the new binary term.
scope.temperature: Activity examples at 1673/1873 K do not validate the 2173.15 K multicomponent continuation.
scope.high_P: The paper explicitly notes sparse liquid thermodynamic evidence beyond about 40 atomic percent P.

decision: Use the accessible five-parameter liquid association law for a conditional finite-P comparison. No empirical multicomponent admission or new physical composition cap.
